instruction: Collection Instances. The Blender executable is `/opt/blender/blender`; use it to open `scene.blend`. `scene.blend` already contains a collection named `Gadget` with a mesh object that uses the mesh datablock `GadgetMesh`. Create three Empty collection instances of `Gadget` and name them `GadgetInstance_1`, `GadgetInstance_2`, and `GadgetInstance_3`. Each Empty must have Instance Type set to Collection and use `Gadget` as its instance collection. Place them at distinct world positions so every pair is more than 0.5 BU apart. Preserve the existing `Gadget` collection and `GadgetMesh`, and do not duplicate the mesh data: the saved file must still contain exactly one mesh datablock overall, named `GadgetMesh`. Save the result as `/home/user/Desktop/answer.blend`.
